recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the published FHIR-I clarification without reintroducing the broader Mixed Normative notes section; any future tooling-specific behavior should be handled separately in the publisher/kindling codebase.
issue_request: FHIR-25744 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked why Pharmacy search parameters appeared normative when Pharmacy had not approved normative content; the resolution required versioning-page guidance and tooling/status support for shared SearchParameters.
initial_application: The versioning-page guidance was originally added by d390dda8cc and refined by 7da9facca1. Follow-up FHIR-25744 commits fede0a9351 and 3c92acb6d1 adjusted SearchParameter standards-status metadata in resource search-parameter bundles after the Jira comment noting kindling/tooling follow-up.
additional_context: source/versions.html is the active Change Management and Versioning page via source/hierarchy.xml. FHIR-47046 later consolidated the notes block that included the FHIR-25744 paragraph, but 7466cfc63c removed that whole Mixed Normative notes block. Current fhir.ini keeps the relevant Pharmacy resources active and non-normative while their search-parameter bundle entries still carry normative SearchParameter definitions, so the FHIR-25744 ambiguity remains current.
reconciliation: Added a focused paragraph after the standards-status table note in source/versions.html explaining that a normative shared SearchParameter definition remains normative, while its use, expression, and resource-specific applicability for trial-use or informative resources remain trial-use and may change as those resources evolve.
source_changes: source/versions.html: restored the shared SearchParameter normativity clarification in the active Change Management and Versioning page.
